suspected_defect: A zero-yield discovery funnel might prompt the workflow to scale the same search channel without a diagnostic gate or to misread zero passing candidates as proof of no viable topic.
completion_condition: The existing runtime must satisfy all nine frozen criteria on four raw normal, boundary, materially-new-channel, and not-applicable cases.
candidate_reason: No candidate was created because the current runtime met the completion condition; adding a rule would be unsupported duplication.
acceptance_rule: 9/9 MET with no fabricated execution or unsupported scientific conclusion.
stop_rule: If accepted, make no runtime edit. Reopen only after an observed run expands a zero-yield same-channel batch, collapses stage denominators, or treats unknown/not-run as failure.
